install.span04: # e go download di model once (~20 GB), then e go start serve am
install.p06: E dey work for NVIDIA DGX Spark and every GB10 machine. Di script dey check every download against di release checksums and e dey show every sudo command before e run am. Read am first if you want.
install.p08: Your oda computers dey use di GB10 model through di local network. For Mac or any oda Linux machine, di same command wey dey up go install di ragon client; e go find di GB10 by itself.
install.p12: For PowerShell. E no need administrator rights to install, then Windows go ask once to set up di agent sandbox. Dem never sign am yet, so Smart App Control must dey off. Read di script.

new.h201: Di desktop app for Mac, Linux and Windows
new.p02: Ragon desktop app put Ask and Work for one window. Work na full workbench for agent sessions: composer wey get files, skills and commands, review pane to stage, revert and commit, worktrees, terminal tabs, and file tree and file tabs beside di thread. For your oda computers, e be client of your GB10, wey e dey find for di local network.
new.p04: Di install command dey put Ragon for Applications beside ragon, and e dey open like any oda app. Apple silicon and Intel, macOS 12 or newer. ragon update dey update am.
new.p06: For di GB10, ragon_<version>_arm64.deb dey install di app, im launcher entry and di ragon-app command, with di sandbox profile wey e need:
new.p07: Then open am from di application menu, or with ragon app. More.
new.p09: Di PowerShell line dey install di app too, for you alone and without administrator rights, with Start menu entry; Settings → Apps go remove am; ragon update dey update am. Smart App Control must dey off.
new.p11: Di release page get di Mac dmg too (Ragon-<version>-arm64-preview.dmg, or x64 for Intel) and di Windows installer (Ragon-Setup-<version>-x64.exe, or arm64). Dem be unsigned previews: if you download dem with browser, dem go block dem di first time. Check each one against di release signed SHA256SUMS first.
new.li12: macOS 15 and newer: drag Ragon go Applications and open am once, then System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. For macOS 14 and older, Control-click di app › Open.
new.li13: Windows: SmartScreen › More info › Run anyway. Smart App Control must dey off.
try.p02: Or put work for tonight queue with /night add <task>: Ragon go work through di queue while you dey sleep, each task for im own git branch, and you go review di branches with coffee for hand.
proof.h201: Your code no dey leave your table — and you fit prove am
proof.p02: Cloud coding agents dey send your source code go anoda person servers. Ragon no dey send am anywhere: di model dey run for your GB10, and nothing inside Ragon dey phone home. No usage analytics, no metrics, no sign-in, no "anonymous" crash reports. Dat one make e fit work for code wey dem no allow you upload: client work, regulated data, unreleased products.
proof.p03: One command dey run real Ragon session under strace and list every network connection wey e make:
proof.p04: Everything stay for 127.0.0.1. Not even one DNS lookup.
proof.p06: Type /airgapped on and every command wey di agent run go get empty network namespace from di Linux kernel. E no be polite request to di model: network just no dey to reach. Full Access, wey for bypass di sandbox, dem go refuse am at di same time.
proof.p08: Only wetin you or di agent ask for: web search (through private SearXNG for your own machine), page fetch, read-only request to Google account wey you connect, or update check. For /airgapped on, none of dem.
why.p03: Di model, your code, your prompts and your answers dey stay for di machine wey dem dey.
why.li05: Egress audit wey you fit run again
why.h315: ✨ Nothing wey you need set up
why.li16: No tuning: model, context, kernels and speculative decoding dem don choose am for di GB10.
why.li17: E no go freeze your machine: dem dey check di host and dey watch memory pressure during di load.
why.li18: Your oda machines go find am for di local network.
features.p03: E dey read your repository, run commands and tests, edit code, and ask before anything wey get risk.
features.p05: /night add <task> before you sleep; each task go finish for im own git branch by morning. Nothing dey merge or push without you.
features.p07: Through private SearXNG for your own machine: no search account, no API key.
features.p09: Definitions, callers and impact across your repository, so di agent go find code instead of to grep for am.
features.h310: 🧩 Your skills wey you don get
features.p11: Skills wey you don write for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw or Hermes dey work as dem be.
features.p13: Questions with web search, image search and dictation, plus your agent sessions, from dis machine or paired phone, on di same local model.
features.p15: Ask and Work for one window, for GB10, Mac, Linux or Windows: agent sessions with approvals, review pane, worktrees and undo.
features.p17: Read-only, through sign-in wey dey stay for your machine. E dey off completely for /airgapped on.
compare.td15: E dey work even if network comot
compare.td18: You fit verify wetin dey comot
machines.h201: E dey run for every GB10
machines.p02: Dem share di chip, di 128 GB unified memory and DGX OS 7, so one installer cover all of dem. Dem dey develop and test Ragon every day for di ASUS Ascent GX10; tests cover di oda ones.
faq.p03: Yes, to run di model. Your oda computers dey use am as clients: Linux (Arm or x86) and macOS with di same install command, Windows (Arm or x86, preview) with di PowerShell line.
faq.p07: Yes. Ragon na open source under di AGPL, and di model weights free. Di only running cost wey you get na electricity.
faq.summary08: Wetin I need apart from di machine?
faq.p09: Di OS wey e come with (DGX OS 7, or Ubuntu 24.04 where di vendor offer am), Docker with di NVIDIA Container Toolkit, Python 3 and Git. For plain Ubuntu, ragon-admin host check go tell you wetin dey miss.
faq.p11: Only wetin you or di agent ask for, like web search through SearXNG for your own machine, and di first-time downloads. /airgapped on dey turn all of am off.
faq.p13: Qwen3.8-27B for NVIDIA 4-bit NVFP4 format, wey our own engine ragon-serve dey serve with DFlash2 drafter (SGLang remain as fallback for all of 0.9.x), dem choose and tune am for di GB10. About 20 GB of weights; roughly 38 GB of di machine memory go remain free while e dey serve.
cta.h201: Keep your code for your table
cta.p02: If you believe say code suppose stay for di table wey dem write am, star di repository: na so oda GB10 owners dey find Ragon.

new.c1_h3: ragon-serve engine, ScaleSearch drafter, and node Forgejo
new.c1_p: ragon-serve dey run Qwen3.8-27B for GB10 with 262K context, every node get im own private Forgejo, and Telegram Mini App dey work straight on top your repo dem.
new.c2_h3: Host socket dem don lock, local file index, and LoRA adapters
new.c2_p: E dey close Docker, containerd, D-Bus and systemd socket inside command sandbox, add OCR and office files join ragon-docs, and serve signed LoRA adapters.
new.c3_h3: Desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows, plus Night Shift best-of-N
new.c3_p: Ask and Work dey stay inside one desktop window with review pane, worktrees and terminal tabs; /night add --best-of N dey run task N times come keep the best one.
surfaces.r3_h3: JetBrains, VS Code, and your phone
surfaces.r3_p: Join JetBrains or VS Code with stdio MCP (ragon-admin mcp), or message your GB10 from Signal (Note to Self), Telegram (with Mini App repo workbench) and Matrix on top Tailscale. Every phone bridge dey off until you turn am on.
